claim_scope: local structural conformance and deterministic command-policy fixture; no LLM quality or provider-cost claim
policy: first exact routing fact matching the requested command
limitations: Synthetic delayed command facts, not autonomous coding agents.
Recovery is task-oracle addressed to isolate snapshot availability; it is not an automatic proof-guided recovery success measurement.
Repeated turns are dependent and cannot serve as iid risk-calibration samples.
Static-prefix and receipt selection strategies are compared at the declared local selected-text budget; full and recovery controls use additional context.
Memory and proof-guided policies are excluded because neither is in the tested path.
No context-risk, adaptive-stopping or runtime-granularity frontier is calibrated by this fixture.
